cases.name: depth-positive
cases.tradeoff: L3 requires a HealthIndicator implementation, health method, and attributed Health status builder call in the same Java class; normal multi-class observability modules are missed.

cases.name: one-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: One required high-precision signal is absent; the depth rule must fail closed.

cases.name: signals-split-across-classes
cases.tradeoff: A Health builder call in another class cannot complete the HealthIndicator implementation.
